messages:
ella_sales: Acme POC: JSON-mode responses are getting cut mid-string, customer parser errors. Anyone?

acme_eng: Error: unexpected end of JSON at pos 1024; snippet shows unclosed quotes. We increased max_tokens but same. request_id: r-2c4d5e6f

sam_se: Are they using json_mode streaming or function_call? Which model/quant?

acme_eng: json_mode streaming, open-instruct-XXL int8

lina_eng: Logs for r-2c4d5e6f show conn write closed (EPIPE) after ~1100 tokens; batch_flush_bytes=1024; json buffer didn't flush final bytes

sam_se: Two immediate mitigations: ask customer to wait longer for stream end (socket timeout 12s) and run jsonlint before persisting; or switch to non-streaming json_mode temporarily

lina_eng: Infra action: bump batch_flush_bytes to 4096 for acme-poc pool and add forced-final-flush guard. ETA 2h

marta_sec: Check logs for PII exposure; if any secrets in truncated fragments, rotate and scrub

acme_eng: We'll add client timeout and jsonlint. Please ping when infra change complete so we can re-test

deploy-bot: ACME-POC-009 queued: bump batch_flush_bytes & guard; smoke tests scheduled

ella_sales: Thanks team, looping in customer now. Keep me posted @sam_se @lina_eng
